runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 19:31 public-web sweep across 13 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade LIVE item was added. Kariera surfaced same-day Bratislava administration inventory. Grafton Receptionist / Office Assistant (1,300–1,400 EUR) initially failed result-page click with a cache miss, then canonical recovery by exact job ID/title succeeded; it is rejected from LIVE because active spoken/written English and advanced Excel/Outlook are explicit requirements. Same-day Telekom Magenta Experience Center is a mirror of an existing direct-company LIVE record. Upwork worldwide VA/support/WordPress candidates were rejected for client-risk, strong English, hard development, low fixed-price economics or unclear workload. Reddit yielded no suitable employer-demand hit. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Canonical detail recovery ladder
developmentChanges.reason: When a promising result-page hit fails to open because of cache/index/redirect errors, automatically retry by exact job ID/title, direct employer ATS and canonical URL discovery before classifying it as inaccessible. This run proved the value: the Grafton receptionist result-page click failed, but exact-ID recovery found the canonical detail and exposed active English plus advanced Excel/Outlook, preventing a false promotion.

developmentChanges.title: Source-family evidence-age SLA
developmentChanges.reason: Persist the age of the newest trustworthy result or crawl evidence for each source family and downgrade a nominally checked family to limited when discovery is only returning stale index material. This distinguishes a genuinely quiet source from stale search indexing and improves the truthfulness of source coverage health.
